key: SAPHIRA: Well met, \PN.
en: SAPHIRA: Well met, \PN.
ja: サファイラ: よく来たね、\PN。

key: I hope you didn't think I would go down without a fight.
en: I hope you didn't think I would go down without a fight.
ja: あたしが黙ってやられるとでも思った?

key: I'll admit that woman caught me off guard.
en: I'll admit that woman caught me off guard.
ja: あの女には、正直不意を突かれたよ。

key: She seemed to know about my family, but I didn't recognize her.
en: She seemed to know about my family, but I didn't recognize her.
ja: あたしの家族のこと知ってるみたいだったけど、あたしには見覚えがなかった。

key: But that doesn't matter anymore.
en: But that doesn't matter anymore.
ja: でも、もうそんなことはどうでもいい。

key: I already snuck back in and terminated their base.
en: I already snuck back in and terminated their base.
ja: こっそり戻って、あいつらの基地はもう壊滅させておいた。

key: And I've got a present for you.
en: And I've got a present for you.
ja: それと、あんたへのプレゼントもある。

key: SAPHIRA: Team Meteor has been desperate to seize these objects.
en: SAPHIRA: Team Meteor has been desperate to seize these objects.
ja: サファイラ: チームメテオは、この品物を必死になって手に入れようとしてた。

key: To give them back to the original owners would do little but paint a target on their backs.
en: To give them back to the original owners would do little but paint a target on their backs.
ja: 元の持ち主に返したところで、標的にされるだけであまり意味はない。

key: Neither can I keep them-- They know where I stay.
en: Neither can I keep them-- They know where I stay.
ja: あたしが持ってるわけにもいかない――あいつらは、あたしの居場所を知ってるから。

key: I need you to take these, and leave.
en: I need you to take these, and leave.
ja: あんたがこれを持って、出ていってほしい。

key: The rest of us will relocate.
en: The rest of us will relocate.
ja: あたしたちは、他の場所に移る。

key: Up north, in the Carnelia Region, there are two cities--
en: Up north, in the Carnelia Region, there are two cities--
ja: 北の方、カーネリア地方には、二つの街がある――

key: Labradorra and Calcenon.
en: Labradorra and Calcenon.
ja: ラブラドラとカルセノン。

key: The Gyms in those cities belong to Charlotte and I.
en: The Gyms in those cities belong to Charlotte and I.
ja: あそこのジムは、あたしとシャルロットのもの。

key: You go your own way, and I'll lead everyone else up there in safety.
en: You go your own way, and I'll lead everyone else up there in safety.
ja: あんたは自分の道を進んで。あたしは他のみんなを、安全にそこまで連れて行くから。

key: North and east of the route ahead is your way forward.
en: North and east of the route ahead is your way forward.
ja: この先の道の北東が、あんたの進む道。

key: Should Team Meteor pursue you for the keys, I trust you are capable of defending them.
en: Should Team Meteor pursue you for the keys, I trust you are capable of defending them.
ja: チームメテオが鍵を狙ってあんたを追ってきても、守り抜けると信じてる。

key: Be careful.
en: Be careful.
ja: 気をつけて。

key: We'll meet again.
en: We'll meet again.
ja: また会おう。
